```{r, COI Overall ~ Cognition}
library(mgcv)
library(dplyr)
library(openxlsx)

data <- read.csv("~/Desktop/ABCD/abcd_coi.csv")


# Z-score scaling
data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    across(ends_with("_Ten1_FA"), scale),
    across(starts_with("nih"), scale),
    across(starts_with("coi"), scale)
  )

# Determine the maximum possible k value
unique_values <- sapply(data[c('coi_total_raw', 'interview_age', 'parenteducation', 'bmi', 'rel_family_id')], 
                        function(x) length(unique(x)))
max_possible_k <- min(unique_values) - 1
k_values <- 3:max_possible_k

# Define NIH columns
nih_columns <- grep("^nih", names(data), value = TRUE)

# Function to fit GAM and extract statistics
fit_gam_and_adjust_p <- function(y_column) {
  models <- list()
  aic_values <- numeric(length(k_values))
  
  # Loop over k values to find the optimal GAM model
  for (i in seq_along(k_values)) {
    k <- k_values[i]
    fit <- tryCatch(
      gam(as.formula(paste(y_column, "~ s(coi_total_raw, k = k) + s(interview_age, k = k) + 
                                       factor(sex) + factor(race) + factor(ethnicity) + 
                                       factor(totalincome) + s(parenteducation, k = k) + 
                                       s(bmi, k=k) + factor(puberty_stage) + 
                                       factor(sleep_category) + factor(fam_hx) + 
                                       factor(site_id_l) + s(rel_family_id, k = k)")), 
          data = data),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
    if (!is.null(fit)) {
      aic_values[i] <- AIC(fit)
      models[[as.character(k)]] <- fit
    } else {
      aic_values[i] <- Inf
    }
  }
  
  # Select the model with the lowest AIC
  best_k_index <- which.min(aic_values)
  best_k <- k_values[best_k_index]
  best_model <- models[[as.character(best_k)]]
  
  if (!is.null(best_model)) {
    best_model_summary <- summary(best_model)
    smoothed_p_values <- if ("s.table" %in% names(best_model_summary)) best_model_summary$s.table[, 4] else NA
    smoothed_terms <- if ("s.table" %in% names(best_model_summary)) rownames(best_model_summary$s.table) else NA
  } else {
    smoothed_p_values <- NA
    smoothed_terms <- NA
  }
  
  list(
    best_model = best_model, 
    best_k = best_k, 
    aic_values = aic_values, 
    p_values = smoothed_p_values, 
    smoothed_terms = smoothed_terms
  )
}


best_models <- list()
best_ks <- list()
p_values_all <- list()
smoothed_terms_all <- list()

# Fit models for all NIH columns
for (nih_col in nih_columns) {
  cat("Processing column:", nih_col, "\n")
  
  result <- fit_gam_and_adjust_p(nih_col)
  
  best_models[[nih_col]] <- result$best_model
  best_ks[[nih_col]] <- result$best_k
  p_values_all[[nih_col]] <- result$p_values
  smoothed_terms_all[[nih_col]] <- result$smoothed_terms
  
  if (!is.null(result$best_model)) {
    cat("Best k:", result$best_k, "\n")
    cat("AIC of best model:", AIC(result$best_model), "\n")
    gam.check(result$best_model)
    print(summary(result$best_model))
  }
}

# FDR correction
all_p_values <- unlist(p_values_all)
fdr_corrected_p_values <- p.adjust(all_p_values, method = "fdr")


corrected_pvalues_df <- data.frame(
  Column = rep(nih_columns, lengths(p_values_all)),
  Term = unlist(smoothed_terms_all),
  CorrectedPValue = ifelse(
    fdr_corrected_p_values < .Machine$double.eps, 
    sprintf("%.25f", fdr_corrected_p_values), 
    format.pval(fdr_corrected_p_values, digits = 20)
  )
) %>%
  filter(Term == "s(coi_total_raw)")

# Initialize results
results_df <- data.frame(
  Column = character(),
  AdjR2 = numeric(),
  DevExp = numeric(),
  FStatistic = numeric(),
  PValue = character(),  
  CorrectedPValue = character(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Store results for each NIH column
for (nih_col in nih_columns) {
  best_model <- best_models[[nih_col]]
  if (!is.null(best_model)) {
    best_model_summary <- summary(best_model)
    adj_r2 <- best_model_summary$r.sq
    dev_exp <- best_model_summary$dev.expl
    
    # Extract F-statistic and p-value for s(coi_overall_raw)
    term_index <- which(rownames(best_model_summary$s.table) == "s(coi_total_raw)")
    
    if (length(term_index) > 0) {
      f_statistic <- best_model_summary$s.table[term_index, "F"]
      raw_pvalue <- best_model_summary$s.table[term_index, "p-value"]
      
     formatted_pvalue <- ifelse(raw_pvalue < .Machine$double.eps, 
                           format(raw_pvalue, scientific = TRUE, digits = 10),  
                           format.pval(raw_pvalue, digits = 10))
      
      corrected_p_value <- corrected_pvalues_df %>%
        filter(Column == nih_col) %>%
        pull(CorrectedPValue)
      
      results_df <- results_df %>% add_row(
        Column = nih_col,
        AdjR2 = adj_r2,
        DevExp = dev_exp,
        FStatistic = f_statistic,
        PValue = formatted_pvalue,  
        CorrectedPValue = corrected_p_value
      )
    }
  }
}

write.xlsx(results_df, "~/Desktop/coi_overall_nih_results.xlsx", rowNames = FALSE)
print(results_df)
```
